title: Structural Engineer Level I
jobDescription:
• We deliver the world’s most complex projects.
  • Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team.
  • Enjoy a varied & challenging role.


Building on our past. Ready for the future

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.

Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.

We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.

  • Key Responsibilities
    • Perform structural analysis and design of Fixed Jacket Structures, Lifted Topsides, and Float‑Over Topsides, covering in‑service, pre‑service, and accidental load cases.
    • Should be able to Develop structural models from scratch, and prepare engineering calculations, reports.
    • Should be able to review the drawings from engineering prespective.
    • Deliver structural engineering work packages within defined scope, budget, and schedule requirements.
    • Coordinate design input with internal disciplines and drafting teams to ensure timely and quality deliverables.
    • Assist in developing design philosophies, analysis methodologies.
    • Participate in technical discussions, interdisciplinary reviews, and model review sessions.
    • Support preparation of RFQs and review vendor documents for steel plates, hot‑rolled sections, tubulars, LMUs, grout seals, anodes, and related items.

    • Contribute to knowledge sharing and promote best practices within the engineering team.

About You

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil/Structural Engineering.
  • 4 to 7 years of relevant experience in offshore structural engineering.
  • Experience in analysis and design of Fixed Template Structures, FPSO modules, and offshore renewable structures (wind, hydrogen, CCS).
  • Good exposure to FEED/EPC project environments.
  • Familiarity with steel material grades, testing requirements, and fabrication specifications.
  • Technical Skills
    • Familiarity with Fatigue analysis, non-linear analysis and FEA analysis.
    • Good understanding of weight control principles for offshore structures.
    • Familiarity with international design codes including ISO 19901, ISO 19902, AISC, API (WSD & LRFD), DNV.
    • Hands‑on experience with tools such as SACS, SESAM, USFOS, ANSYS, ABAQUS, STAAD.
    • Experience with Python/VBA automation.
  • Soft Skills
    • Strong communication skills for coordination with internal teams and external stakeholders.
    • Ability to work independently under supervision of senior engineers with sound engineering judgment.
    • Proactive attitude toward learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.

We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.

Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

Worley takes personal data protection seriously and respects EU and local data protection laws. You can read our full Recruitment Privacy Notice Here.

Please note: If you are being represented by a recruitment agency you will not be considered, to be considered you will need to apply directly to Worley.

title: Safety Engineer Level I
jobDescription:
About us

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

The Role

As a Safety Engineer Level I with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

  • Supports adherence to generally accepted engineering and design practices, regulatory requirements, and customer specifications.
  • Supports the standardization of equipment specifications, drawings, and document templates.
  • Contributes to the understanding of technical knowledge, legal requirements, and customer specifications whenever viable and lawful.
  • Uses local/global standards to support technical excellence.
  • Supports the processes for checking, peer reviews, and incorporation of comments and findings.
  • Ensure recognised onshore & offshore engineering practices applicable to safety & risk design are adopted.
  • Development of design and operational engineering studies in the areas of risk, safety and Safety & Risk.
  • Designs Safety & Risk scope of work in contract and stewards design alternative studies, as required, to optimize project cost and schedule.
  • Gathering and compiling safety and environmental information.
  • Prepares and assists in the execution of: Hazard Studies (HAZID- ENVID/HAZOP/LOPA); HSE Checklist and Design Basis; Design HSE Review such as Human Factors, Hazardous Area Classification, Inherent Safety, Alarm Prioritisation.

About You

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

Industry Specific Experience:

  • Have engineering experience in Brown Field oil and gas related Safety & Risk Design and Engineering.
  • Must have 5+ years experience in the same or similar industry, including experience in multi-disciplinary projects and teams.
  • Experience in the Middle East, is an advantage.
  • Working as a Safety and Risk Engineer (Technical Safety / Loss Prevention) in the Oil and Gas Industry.
  • Must have experience in offshore projects.

Education – Qualifications, Accreditation, Training:

  • Full-Time Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical Engineering/mechanical Engineering from an accredited university.
  • Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng)/CFPS status or undertaking the same will be an advantage.

IT SKILLS:

  • PIPENET, PHAST, SAFETI, PHA Pro, Flaresim, Detect3D (optional), ex SILentia (optional).

Key areas of expertise required:

  • Active Fire Protection (Firewater demand, hydraulic analysis, P&IDs, PFDs, etc).
  • F&G layouts, C/E diagrams.
  • Passive Fire Protection.
  • Datasheets and specifications, MTO.
  • Hazardous Area Classification (Schedule and Drawings).
  • Good knowledge of NFPA and International Standards for Technical Safety / Loss Prevention.
  • Consequence analysis (gas dispersion, toxic, fires, explosion, vent dispersion, flare radiation modeling).
  • Safety Critical Elements and Performance Standards.
  • Risk Register / action follow-up and close-out.
  • ALARP assessment, Bow-ties, and Cost-Benefit analysis.

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

Position Summary
The Expeditor II is responsible for ensuring the timely delivery of materials, equipment, and documentation required for projects. The role involves proactive monitoring of supplier performance, identifying potential delays, coordinating corrective actions, and providing accurate status reporting to support project execution schedules.
The Expeditor acts as the primary interface between suppliers, client, procurement, engineering, quality, logistics, and project management teams to ensure on-time delivery and compliance with contractual requirements.


The Role

As an Expeditor II with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:
Expediting & Supplier Management

  • Monitor supplier progress against approved manufacturing, engineering, procurement, and delivery schedules.
  • Review purchase orders and contractual delivery requirements.
  • Conduct regular follow-up with suppliers to ensure compliance with project milestones.
  • Identify schedule risks, delays, and bottlenecks and implement mitigation plans.
  • Conduct supplier kick-off meetings and progress review meetings.
  • Coordinate with suppliers to expedite critical equipment and materials.
  • Ensure suppliers maintain adequate resources and manufacturing capacity to meet project schedules.

Progress Monitoring & Reporting

  • Track engineering, procurement, manufacturing, inspection, testing, and shipment activities.
  • Maintain Material Status Reports (MSR), Expediting Reports, and Supplier Progress Reports.
  • Provide accurate and timely updates to project stakeholders.
  • Generate weekly and monthly performance reports highlighting critical issues and recovery actions.
  • Monitor supplier KPIs and delivery performance metrics.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Liaise closely with Procurement, Engineering, QA/QC, Inspection, Logistics, and Construction teams.
  • Coordinate resolution of technical, commercial, quality, and logistical issues impacting delivery schedules.
  • Support project teams during critical procurement and execution phases.
  • Ensure alignment between supplier schedules and overall project milestones.

Role & Audits

  • Conduct desk expediting activities.
  • Review field expediting & inspection visit reports and recommend corrective actions where necessary.
  • Participate in supplier audits and performance evaluations.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Proactively Monitor submission and approval of supplier documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with project specifications, contractual requirements, and client standards,
  • Verify completion of inspection, testing, certification, and shipping documentation prior to delivery.
  • Support document control and close-out activities.

Logistics Coordination

  • Coordinate with logistics teams to ensure timely shipment and delivery.
  • Monitor, Track & verify the packing list, N/N documents, preservation, transportation, and customs clearance activities.
  • Identify and coordinate logistics-related delays.

About You

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Production Engineering...
  • Equivalent industry experience may be considered.

Experience

  • Minimum 8-13 years of experience in expediting, procurement, supply chain, or project execution within the Oil & Gas, LNG, Chemical, Petrochemical, Refining, or Energy sectors.
  • Experience with EPC, EPCM, or major capital projects is preferred.
  • Proven experience managing critical equipment suppliers and international supply chains.

Technical Knowledge
Experience with procurement and expediting of:

  • Columns
  • Reactors
  • Pressure Vessels
  • Heat Exchangers
  • Pumps
  • Compressors
  • Packages and Skids
  • Valves
  • Piping Materials
  • Structural Steel
  • Electrical Equipment
  • Instrumentation & Control Systems

Knowledge of:

  • Manufacturing processes and fabrication activities
  • Vendor document review cycles
  • Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs)
  • International logistics and shipping processes

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent verbal & written communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong project scheduling and planning skills.
  • Excellent supplier management and negotiation abilities.
  • Ability to identify risks and drive recovery actions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Project, ERP systems (SAP, ERM, Oracle, Aconex etc.), and reporting tools.
  • Ability to work under pressure in fast-track project environments.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking capabilities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • On-time delivery performance.
  • Reduction of supplier delays and schedule slippages.
  • Accuracy and timeliness of status reporting.
  • Supplier responsiveness and recovery effectiveness.
  • Critical path material delivery compliance.
  • Documentation submission and approval performance.
  • Project schedule adherence.

  • Use of systems and digital tools, including adherence to data quality expectations and proactive adoption of digital and analytical solutions.

title: Structural Designer Level II
jobDescription:
About us
Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

The Role

As a Structural Designer Level II with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

  • Develop and update 2D drawings and 3D models for offshore structures (platforms, jackets, modules, pipe racks).
  • Prepare GA drawings, fabrication drawings, erection drawings, and detailing layouts.
  • Interpret design calculations, engineering sketches, and specifications to produce ccurate deliverables.
  • Model structural steel components using software such as Tekla, SP3D, or PDMS/E3D.
  • Ensure compliance with industry codes and standards (API, AISC, ISO, DNV, ABS).
  • Participate in model reviews, clash checks, and design reviews.
  • Prepare material take-offs (MTO) and support procurement activities.
  • Assist in construction/fabrication queries and provide design clarifications.
  • Maintain quality, accuracy, and schedule adherence of project deliverables.
  • Implement project standards, QA/QC procedures, and best practices.

Other Attributes:

  • Independent contributor responsible for detailed structural design and coordination for offshore projects.
  • Responsible for detailed design and drafting of offshore structural components such as jackets, topsides, decks, modules, and supports.
  • Works closely with structural engineers to convert engineering concepts into detailed 2D drawings and 3D models.
  • Ensures designs comply with offshore standards, project specifications, and safety requirements.
  • Supports project execution through all phases: concept, FEED, detailed engineering, and fabrication.

About You

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Civil / Structural Engineering.
  • Typically 7 to 18 years of experience in offshore / oil & gas / heavy engineering projects.
  • Experience in offshore structural design and detailing is mandatory.
  • Familiarity with fabrication and construction practices for offshore structures.
  • Exposure to FEED and detailed engineering projects preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in structural modeling tools:
    • Tekla Structures
    • Smart Plant 3D (SP3D) / AVEVA E3D / PDMS
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • Structural steel detailing and connections
    • Offshore structures (jackets, topsides, modules)
  • Structural Detailing knowledge as per design codes:
    • AWD 1.1, API RP 2A, AISC
  • Ability to generate:
    • GA drawings, shop drawings, and fabrication details
  • Familiar with:
    • Navisworks / clash detection tools
    • Material take-offs and BOM preparation
  • Good understanding of:
    • Welding symbols, tolerances, and fabrication standards

Soft Skills

  • Good communication and coordination skills across disciplines.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to work under tight deadlines and manage priorities.
  • Problem-solving mindset with proactive approach.
  • Adaptability to project requirements and changing design conditions.
  • Team-oriented with ability to collaborate in global project environments.
